confidence_notes: Food prices are uncertain: city cost indexes and Samoa-wide meal guides differ substantially on inexpensive meals. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with high uncertainty. Cocktail is estimated from local beer prices; wine by the glass is estimated from beer prices and typical bottle-to-glass pricing.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food and drink estimates draw on Apia and Samoa price information, while accommodation is a holistic estimate for a small Pacific island capital.
